hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; err=$(ruff check "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$err" >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */frontend/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d="${f%/frontend/*}/frontend"; cd "$d" || exit 0; npx eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; err=$(npx eslint "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$err" >&2; exit 2; fi
